title: Planning is guessing
coreMove: Forecast humility treats plans as provisional bets, so current evidence can update the work before an old document becomes the boss.

exampleSpecs.stakes: replace false annual certainty with current-week evidence
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the protagonist uses the 37signals current-week stance

exampleSpecs.stakes: avoid treating a staffing guess as a promise
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the protagonist adjusts a hiring plan after new cost evidence

exampleSpecs.stakes: respond to demand without losing direction
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the protagonist changes the plan after real ticket behavior

exampleSpecs.stakes: keep estimates useful without making them binding
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the protagonist marks which plan lines are guesses

exampleSpecs.stakes: avoid defending a forecast after customer evidence changes
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the protagonist refuses to treat revision as embarrassment

exampleSpecs.stakes: plan enough to coordinate while leaving room for discovery
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the protagonist keeps preparation but drops false precision
